evidence: Runtime help and session-entry copy still claim a mutating resume gate exists after c772497c retired it.
recommendation: Remove gate-armed, gate-lifted, and mutation-refusal claims from every live help, session-entry, command, and manpage surface; add a semantic parity witness for the retired doctrine.

evidence: resume_handoff parses and selects but does not return full document validation, branch reconciliation, claim verdicts, or bearing despite the canonical RESUME contract promising validation and reconciliation.
recommendation: Make one structured session-entry assessment validate the selected document, reconcile current authorities, classify each load-bearing claim, and render an advisory bearing verdict.

evidence: create_handoff writes a deterministic timestamp-plus-slug path with write_text and no destination-exists refusal.
recommendation: Refuse an existing destination before writing, constrain the slug to the canonical safe form, and pin overwrite refusal with a behavior test.

evidence: Live RESUME classifies by elapsed time while doctrine declares time, commits, files, and branch divergence; Unknown is currently treated as Fresh.
recommendation: Unify freshness and orientation around one drift assessment; retain unknown as UNVERIFIED and let the worst verified factor drive the advisory result.

evidence: User and GovZero pages still prescribe per-ADR storage, omit CHECKPOINT, and cite nonexistent test modules after the consolidated register shipped.
recommendation: Reconcile every handoff user and governance page to the current register, modes, source modules, and tests; remove historical architecture from current-contract pages.

evidence: Predecessor resolution can accept paths outside canonical stores; missing predecessors, cycles, and traversal truncation are silently skipped or collapsed rather than returned as lineage warnings.
recommendation: Confine predecessors to repository handoff stores and return explicit dangling, cycle, and truncation findings; distinguish traversal depth from node budget.

evidence: Claude receives session-start advisement plus the richer orientation path, while Codex primarily consumes orientation; duplicated rendering and selection produce harness-dependent semantics.
recommendation: Make every harness consume one structured session-entry assessment and reduce secondary hooks to thin renderers or pointers.

evidence: Branch and agent are string parameters but the handoff frontmatter model does not enforce stripped non-empty identity values.
recommendation: Require stripped non-empty branch and agent values, validate session identifiers through the canonical model, and add negative tests at API and CLI seams.

evidence: ResumeResult exposes selected content and extracted items but no structured claim-to-evidence assessment or CONTINUE/REVISE/ABANDON/VERIFY bearing.
recommendation: Add an advisory bearing projection with per-step preconditions and an exact start-here-because statement; never turn it into a mutation gate.

evidence: All active mirrors declare skill-version 7.0.0, GovZero framework v6, and title v6.20.0 simultaneously.
recommendation: Choose one authoritative skill identity, reconcile title and metadata, apply the declared framework-major policy, and sync all mirrors.

evidence: A 30-day archive dry run found 11 movable entries, 87 lock-protected entries, and 111 chain-protected entries.
recommendation: Either describe retention as archiving isolated eligible records or design atomic closed-chain moves with stable identifiers and pointer repair.

evidence: The detector covers several common assignment and token forms but not many vendor prefixes, colon forms, credential URLs, or entropy-based secrets.
recommendation: Describe the current check as common-pattern screening or adopt a governed detector with explicit supported patterns and false-positive policy.
